newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: SOCCER-NEFTCHI WIN AZERI LEAGUE BUT RIVALS SET FOR EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEFTCHI WIN AZERI LEAGUE BUT RIVALS SET FOR EUROPE.

text.p: Azerbaijan's Neftchi Baku secured their second successive league title with a 4-0 win over Mingechaur at the weekend. But rivals Karabakh Agdam are likely to take the former Soviet republic's European Cup place.
Karabakh, who have one game left to play next weekend, are in second place, six points behind Neftchi in the senior league.

But soccer officials in the capital Baku said on Monday the Agdam club were almost certain to win the "club championship" and with it Azerbaijan's berth in the European Cup qualifying round under new rules that take into account the performance of clubs' youth sides.
The system, introduced in Azerbaijan this season, is designed to promote youth soccer.
Karabakh have been unable to play at home since 1993 when they last won the league title.

In the summer of that year mainly Moslem Agdam was overrun by Christian Armenian forces consolidating their hold on the disputed nearby region of Nagorno-Karabakh. The city of 100,000 has become a ghost town.
